text_en: Masters, treat your slaves justly and fairly, for you know that you also have a Master in heaven.
text_cn: 作主人的，要以正义公平对待奴仆，因为该知道，你们在天上也有一位主子。

text_en: Devote yourselves to prayer, keeping alert in it with thanksgiving.
text_cn: 你们要恒心祈祷，在祈祷中要醒寤，要谢恩；

text_en: At the same time pray for us as well that God will open to us a door for the word, that we may declare the mystery of Christ, for which I am in prison,
text_cn: 同时，也要为我们祈祷，求天主给我们大开传道之门，好叫我能以宣讲基督的奥秘──我就是为此带上了锁链──

text_en: so that I may reveal it clearly, as I should.
text_cn: 好叫我能照我该说的，把这奥秘传扬出去。

text_en: Conduct yourselves wisely toward outsiders, making the most of the time.
text_cn: 与外人来往要有智慧，要把握时机。

text_en: Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how you ought to answer everyone.
text_cn: 你们的言谈常要温和，像调和上了盐；要知道应如何答复每个人。

text_en: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me; he is a beloved brother, a faithful minister, and a fellow servant in the Lord.
text_cn: 关于我的一切，有我们亲爱的弟兄，忠信的服务者及在主内的同仆提希苛，告诉你们。

text_en: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, so that you may know how we are and that he may encourage your hearts;
text_cn: 我打发他到你们那里去，就是为把我们的事报告给你们，并为安慰你们的心。

text_en: he is coming with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will tell you about everything here.
text_cn: 和他同去的，还有忠信亲爱的弟兄敖乃息摩，他原是你们的同乡；他们会把这里的一切事报告给你们。

text_en: Aristarchus my fellow prisoner greets you, as does Mark the cousin of Barnabas, concerning whom you have received instructions—if he comes to you, welcome him.
text_cn: 我的囚伴阿黎斯塔苛问候你们，巴尔纳伯的表弟马尔谷也问候你们──关于他，你们已获得了指示；如果他到了你们那里，你们要接待他──

text_en: And Jesus who is called Justus greets you. These are the only ones of the circumcision among my co-workers for the kingdom of God, and they have been a comfort to me.
text_cn: 还有号称犹斯托的耶稣，也问候你们；受割损的人中，只有这些人对天主的国是合作的人，他们这样的人才是我的安慰。

text_en: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ Jesus, greets you. He is always wrestling in his prayers on your behalf, so that you may stand mature and fully assured in everything that God wills.
text_cn: 你们的同乡，基督耶稣的奴仆厄帕夫辣问候你们，他在祈祷中常为你们苦求，为使你们能坚定不移，在天主所愿意的一切事上，作成全兼诚服的人。

text_en: For I testify for him that he has worked hard for you and for those in Laodicea and in Hierapolis.
text_cn: 我实在能给他作证：他为你们和在劳狄刻雅及耶辣颇里的人受了许多辛苦。

text_en: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas greet you.
text_cn: 亲爱的医生路加和德玛斯问候你们。

text_en: Give my greetings to the brothers and sisters in Laodicea, and to Nympha and the church in her house.
text_cn: 请你们问候劳狄刻雅的弟兄，也问候宁法和她家里的教会。

text_en: And when this letter has been read among you, have it read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and see that you read also the letter from Laodicea.
text_cn: 几时你们宣读了这封信，务要使这封信也在劳狄刻雅人的教会内宣读；至于那由劳狄刻雅转来的信，你们也要宣读。

text_en: And say to Archippus, “See that you complete the task that you have received in the Lord. ”
text_cn: 请你们告诉阿尔希颇：“要留心你在主内所接受的职分，务要善尽此职！”

text_en: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.
text_cn: 我保禄亲笔问候；你们要念及我的锁链！愿恩宠与你们同在！
